options.content: Inventory, cash, total marked value, wealth, and step economics.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time", 'local_inventory' AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_inventory'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_inventory'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_inventory'] IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT e.ts AS "time", 'global_inventory' AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_inventory'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_inventory'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_inventory'] IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_inventory'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END) AS global_inventory,
         COALESCE(
           CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','config','reference_price'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','config','reference_price'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END,
           CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_sell_vwap'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_sell_vwap'], ''))::double precision

  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_sell_vwap'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL

  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END,
           0.0
         ) AS reference_vwap
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))

SELECT "time", 'total_cash' AS metric,
       (local_cash + global_cash) AS value
FROM state_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT "time", 'total_inventory_value',
       ((local_inventory + global_inventory) * reference_vwap) AS value
FROM state_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT "time", 'total_wealth',
       (local_cash + global_cash + (local_inventory + global_inventory) * reference_vwap) AS value
FROM state_rows
ORDER BY 1

scope_rows AS (
  SELECT "time", 'local' AS metric,
         local_cash AS cash,
         local_inventory AS inventory,
         local_mark_price AS mark_price
  FROM state_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", 'global',
         global_cash,
         global_inventory,
         global_mark_price
  FROM state_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", 'total',
         (local_cash + global_cash),
         (local_inventory + global_inventory),
         total_mark_price
  FROM state_rows
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT "time",
         metric,
         cash,
         inventory,
         mark_price,
         LAG(cash) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY "time") AS cash_prev,
         LAG(inventory) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY "time") AS inventory_prev,
         LAG(mark_price) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY "time") AS mark_price_prev
  FROM scope_rows
),
step_parts AS (
  SELECT "time",
         metric,
         (cash - cash_prev) AS delta_cash,

list.definition:
SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
    AND event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gates.key AS exchange, e.ts
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
    COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
  ) AS gates(key, value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
    AND gates.key IS NOT NULL
    AND gates.key <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'MarketEvent'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('PrivateStateSnapshot', 'VenueLedgerSnapshot')
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(
      exchange,
      payload->>'exchange',
      substring(topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$'),
      substring(topic from '^ledger:snapshot:([^:]+)$')
    ) AS exchange,
    ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('PrivateStateSnapshot', 'VenueLedgerSnapshot')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC

FROM (
  SELECT run_id, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL AND run_id <> ''
  GROUP BY run_id
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC

  FROM mm_events

) ranked

list.definition:
SELECT interval_ms
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) AS interval_ms, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) <> ''
  GROUP BY 1
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
